content.comment_body: I'm facing the same issue as [user_name]. The difference is, I don't use [product_name] Web Editor and do all the programming with [product_name] Soft Comfort. Currently, I'm working with four [product_name] units, one of which does not have an SD card. When I try to access this unit, I receive a message stating that the web server is disabled, which makes sense. My question is: what might I be missing or doing incorrectly?

If you don't have a Web Editor project, why are you posting in this topic? Consider creating a dedicated thread for your scenario. Are you certain the web server feature is activated on your [product_name] units?

Apologies, this was the only relevant thread I came across on the forum. To answer your question, I believe the web server is enabled. I was able to view the [product_name] operator device once. All units lack a display.
That's why it would be better to start your own topic. Also, saying "I think the web server is activated" is not very clear. Is it actually enabled? By default, it is not activated.
Thank you, I'll create a new post. First, I'll double-check whether the web server is enabled.
What is the process for enabling and accessing the web server on [product_name]?

My English is not the best, so I rely on Google Translate. Sorry about that. Regarding your first question: In [product_name] Soft Comfort, go to Tools -> transfer -> access control and make sure everything is checked and active. I access the unit in Chrome by entering its LAN IP address. Example IPs without or with SD card all allow web server access. All basis modules are without display. Password changes will be handled later; for now, I'm keeping the setup simple. Additional question: what is the maximum password length?
Did you activate it following the correct instructions? The user must manually enable the web server; by default, it isn’t switched on.
Previously, I could view the [product_name] operator device via LAN. Now, I continually receive a '404 Target not found' error.
After spending a lot of time, I think I've identified the issue. Google Chrome always shows the same error. When I try with Edge, the problem disappears. Any idea why?
I can use multiple browsers without issues: - Microsoft IE11 - Microsoft Edge - Mozilla Firefox - Google Chrome - Opera
Does having an ad blocker enabled cause this problem?
I'm out of ideas. Restarting the PC didn’t help. Chrome still won’t work. For now, I'll use Edge to view the [product_name] operator device on my computer screen. Thanks for the support, [user_name].
Try clearing Chrome's history and cache or reinstalling Chrome. If that doesn't resolve the issue, your firewall or antivirus software might be blocking access.
It seems to behave the same in Edge and Chrome...
I'm using the default antivirus with Windows 10. I'll need to check the firewall settings, but Edge works without problems and nothing has changed. Thanks for helping me troubleshoot.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to enable and access the web server on several [product_name] units using [product_name] Soft Comfort. Although the web server shows as enabled in the software, connection issues still occur, such as receiving a '404 Target not found' error when reaching certain devices via LAN. Access to an operator device was occasionally successful, indicating the activation workflow for the web server may be inconsistent, especially for devices lacking a display or SD card.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple and reliable approach to activate, check, and access the web server on all their [product_name] devices, regardless of SD card or display status. Clear feedback and documentation on the server’s status and password requirements are also expected.
